class Node:
    def __init__(self, x):
        self.data = x
        self.next = None

def splitList(head):
    slow = head
    fast = head
    if head is None:
        return [None, None]
    
    while fast.next != head and fast.next.next != head:
        fast = fast.next.next
        slow = slow.next
        
    if fast.next.next == head:
        fast = fast.next
        
    head1 = head
    head2 = slow.next
    
    fast.next = slow.next
    slow.next = head
    
    return [head1, head2]

def print_list(head):
    curr = head
    if head is not None:
        while True:
            print(curr.data, end=" ")
            curr = curr.next
            if curr == head:
                break
        print()

    head = Node(10)
    head.next = Node(4)
    head.next.next = Node(9)
    head.next.next.next = head
    
    result = splitList(head)
    head1 = result[0]
    head2 = result[1]
    
    print("First Half:")
    print_list(head1)
    
    print("Second Half:")
